intro.title: Promises & Async/Await
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple program that simulates fetching data from a server using JavaScript's Promise and async/await syntax. You'll learn how to handle asynchronous operations, which are tasks like reading files or making network requests that take time to complete. The core concepts covered include creating Promises, using .then() and .catch() for handling results and errors, and writing cleaner code with async functions and the await keyword. By the end, you'll understand how to manage delayed tasks in JavaScript without blocking your program's execution.
intro.usecase: Promises and async/await are essential for handling asynchronous operations in modern web applications. You'll use them when fetching data from APIs to populate dashboards with real-time metrics, submitting form data without page reloads, or loading user profiles and content dynamically. These patterns ensure smooth user experiences in features like live search filters, infinite scrolling feeds, and interactive data visualizations that update without blocking the UI.
